title: Training Flight
description: Build a safe beginner plane for a short practice trip.
goal: Create a simple, safe starter plane.

title: School Supply Delivery
description: A nearby town needs books and supplies. Build a cargo plane for the job.
goal: Carry boxes safely to the destination.

title: Rescue Mission
description: A rescue team needs a guided aircraft to help in a difficult area.
goal: Build a safer rescue plane with guidance.

title: Passenger Shuttle
description: Build a comfortable plane to carry passengers on a short trip.

title: Long Journey Flight
description: This mission needs a plane that can travel farther with better support systems.
goal: Prepare an aircraft for a longer and smarter journey.

title: Storm Watch Flight
description: Fly safely through changing weather and report the storm path.
goal: Use stable flight systems to survive rough weather.

title: Island Rescue
description: Reach a distant island and deliver emergency help.
goal: Build a smart and dependable rescue aircraft.

title: Heavy Cargo Lift
description: Carry big machine parts to a work site.
goal: Lift more weight without losing stability.

title: Eco Training Challenge
description: Build a low-cost learning plane with smart support power.
goal: Use simple systems and efficient support power.

title: Mountain Survey
description: Scan difficult mountain routes for safe paths.
goal: Build a survey aircraft with eyes in the sky.
